company.name: RALPRO Industries
company.tagline: Excellence in Aluminium Extrusion and Machining
company.description:
RALPRO (Ramse Aluminium Products) has been created with the vision of providing a superior quality product to clients both in domestic and international markets. Ralpro now is one of the leading producers of quality aluminium extruded products across industries such as construction, HVAC, electrical, solar and many more.

Ralpro consists of two presses both equipped with automated PLC controlled hydraulic Extrusion presses of 880 MT and 1450 MT respectively with installed combined capacity of 6000 MT per annum.
